text.p: ValliCorp Holdings Inc. said Wednesday it called off the preliminary merger talks with an unidentified bank holding company.
The company had announced the talks on Sept. 9.
ValliCorp representatives were not immediately available for comment.
The Fresno, Calif.-based company indicated that its board of directors continued to evaluate all of the options available to it, including remaining independent.
ValliCorp has about $1.4 billion in assets and 58 branches in central California. Its stock fell $2.75 to $15.50 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
